description: Agent Operations: submit a list of running agents or jobs as reported (name, status, last activity, pending question or blocker, deadline and recent errors where stated) with the time of the snapshot. The signed brief triages them in priority order: which need the human first and why (deadline passed, error loop, stopped with an error, blocked on an answer, deadline at risk), which look stalled, which run fine and which finished. Supplied status only: the agents are read from the list and never polled. Verdict human_needed, stalled_or_unclear or all_clear. POST /api/agent-attention-brief. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-operations-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-operations/.

pending_question.description: A question it is waiting on.

status.description: Status as reported, such as running, blocked, failed or done.

as_of.description: The time of the status snapshot, as an ISO date-time.

deadline_warning_hours.description: Hours before a deadline at which it reads as at risk. Defaults to 24.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

stall_after_minutes.description: Minutes without activity after which a running agent reads as stalled. Defaults to 60.

name: wever_agent-attention-brief
title: Agent attention brief
